    df = df[df['cause'].notna() & (df['cause'] != 'U')]
    return df[['region','cause']]

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

def process(cause_region_crosstab) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Drop label column and ensure numeric matrix
    cols = [c for c in cause_region_crosstab.columns if c != 'region']
    table = cause_region_crosstab[cols].to_numpy()
    chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(table)
    return pd.DataFrame([{'chi2': float(chi2), 'p_value': float(p)}])
